title_zh: 选一本适合共读的温暖故事

scenario.goal_zh: 比较故事题材与讨论安排后选定共读作品

context_zh: 刚搬来的索拉向图书管理员询问读书小组，希望找到轻松阅读和认识邻居的机会。
author: author-phase05-c

sentences.speaker: Sora
sentences.text: I love literature, but I have not joined a reading group before.

sentences.speaker: Ned
sentences.text: What do you like to read in your leisure time?

sentences.speaker: Sora
sentences.text: Usually crime stories, though I am not in the mood for anything dark at the moment.

sentences.speaker: Ned
sentences.text: Then you might prefer The Harbour Kitchen to our other choice, Winter Trial. One is about neighbours opening a cafe; the other is a courtroom drama.

sentences.speaker: Sora
sentences.text: The cafe story sounds warmer. I have felt a little lonely since I moved here.

sentences.speaker: Ned
sentences.text: Our group is friendly, and you can listen at first if you do not feel like speaking.

sentences.speaker: Sora
sentences.text: When would we discuss The Harbour Kitchen?

sentences.speaker: Ned
sentences.text: Next Thursday at seven. We are only reading the first four chapters for that meeting.

sentences.speaker: Sora
sentences.text: That feels manageable. I will borrow it today and join you on Thursday.

sentences.speaker: Ned
sentences.text: Lovely. We meet at the round table upstairs.
